MRI Information
The Helix Pacing System is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5-Tesla when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Gradient slew rate limited to 150 T/m/s per axis.
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode.
- WB-SAR ≤ 0.4 W/kg.
- head SAR ≤ 3.2 W/kg.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
